name: Creative Expression (Pictionary/Audio/Video)
summary: Learners draw, record audio, or record video to demonstrate understanding. Peers guess or evaluate responses, adding collaborative assessment.

aiGenerability.notes: AI generates prompts excellently. AI cannot auto-grade creative (drawing, audio, video) output without rubric. Peer evaluation is essential. AI can generate feedback frameworks and analytic prompts.

prompt.description: The creative prompt (e.g., 'Draw the water cycle', 'Explain photosynthesis in 30 seconds', 'Record your pronunciation of these words').

mediaType.description: Type of creative expression: drawing (canvas), audio (voice recording), or video (camera + audio).

maxDuration.description: Time limit in seconds for audio or video recordings (typical 15-120s). Not applicable for drawing.

peerGuessing.description: For drawing: whether other peers guess the concept from the drawing (Pictionary-style).

peerVoting.description: Whether peers vote on creativity, clarity, or correctness of responses.

rubric.description: Optional peer-evaluation rubric (e.g., [{ criterion: 'Clarity', weight: 0.5 }, { criterion: 'Creativity', weight: 0.5 }]).

exampleResponse.description: Optional teacher example (video, drawing, or audio sample) to model expectations.

timePerResponse.description: Display time in seconds per response during peer review (typical 10-20s).

ux.mobileNotes: Drawing: full-screen canvas with color palette (top) and eraser/undo (floating buttons). Paint bucket, line weight sliders. Save/submit button. Audio: large record button (center), timer, waveform visualization, playback controls. Video: camera view with record overlay timer, preview thumbnail. Peer review: full-screen playback of each submission (drawing/audio/video) with voting buttons below, comment optional.

ageAdaptations.8-10: Drawing only. Simple prompts (e.g., 'Draw a plant with roots and leaves'). No time pressure or short limit (120s+). Peer guessing optional. Teacher feedback emphasized over peer voting.
ageAdaptations.11-13: Drawing + audio. Moderate prompts (e.g., 'Record yourself explaining the water cycle'). Time limits (30-60s for audio). Simple peer rubric (2 dimensions). Optional comment. Guessing enabled for drawing.
ageAdaptations.14-16: All media types (drawing, audio, video). Complex prompts with sub-requirements. Strict time limits (15-45s for audio/video). Multi-criteria rubric (4+ dimensions). Mandatory peer comments. Optional voice emphasis (pronunciation, fluency). Trading/comparison features.
